sourceOfTruth.specification: docs/careerfit/sources (TIMS: workbook, model config, reference engine)
sourceOfTruth.legacyBaseline: formmaps-platform api GET /api/v1/careers/score (shadow target, not a behavioural spec)

decisions: Self-only 360 in V1 (multi-rater is V1.1): measured identical to 4-source for ranking.
Bounded context inside services/api, same shape as LiaScoring / VocationalScoring; flag FORMMAPS_ROUTE_CAREERFIT_TO_DOTNET.
FormMaps drafts the configuration, TIMS ratifies it; every drafted number carries its derivation.
globalGuardrails: No engine code before the Monte Carlo gate is green on the rule set it will load (tools/careerfit/mc_gate.py).
No VARIABLE / INHERIT / X/Y marker may reach a scoring function: the resolver fails closed.
CareerFitAbsolute is never presented as a percentage; the ranking and the gates are the product.
Every rule-set version is reproducible from docs/careerfit/sources by tools/careerfit/build_rules.py --check.
Inherit RLS and tenant context from services/api; no CareerFit table without a school scope.
